```{r}
# Libraries
library(here) #set local working directory
library(tidyverse) #for data manipulation
library(lme4) #for mixed effects model
library(emmeans) #for calculating estimated marginal means
library(multcomp) #for calculating CIs and tukey test
library(multcompView) #for labeling with letters
library(sjPlot) #for plotting linear model
```

```{r include = FALSE}
# Import data
data <- read_csv(here("data", "VanScoyoc_et_al_data.csv"))
head(data)

```

```{r}
# Create new columns
full_dat <- full_dat %>% 
        mutate(pr_change = ifelse(abs(pr_shift_diurnal) < 0.1 | abs(py_shift_dirunal) < 0.1, 
                                  "Not Significant", "Significant"), #note if shift is > 10%
               hypothesis = ifelse(pr_shift_diurnal < 0 & py_shift_diurnal < 0, "Mutual Avoidance", 
                          ifelse(pr_shift_diurnal > 0 & py_shift_diurnal > 0, "Mutual Attraction",
                            ifelse(pr_shift_diurnal > 0 & py_shift_diurnal < 0, "Prey Switching",
                              ifelse(pr_shift_diurnal < 0 & py_shift_diurnal > 0, "Prey Refuge", 
                                     "Neutral")))))
# Filter dataset
filtered_dat <- full_dat %>% 
        filter(hypothesis != "Neutral") # remove neutral hypotheses
                #overlap_low >= 0.5 &  # filter to strong starting interaction 
                #pr_change == "Significant" & # filter to > 10% shift

```

```{r}
# Run mixed effects model on filtered data
model <- lmer(change_overlap ~ hypothesis + (1|reference), data = filtered_dat)
summary(model)

# Plot
ggplot(filtered_dat,aes(x=reference,y=change_overlap,color=hypothesis))+
  geom_point()+ #add points
  geom_line()+ #add line
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + #set x-axis line
  coord_flip() #flip axes
```
```{r}
# Separate data to create ID pairs for pseudoreplication
pred <- full_dat %>% 
  dplyr::select(reference, name = predator_common, change_overlap, shift_diurnal = pr_shift_diurnal) %>% 
  mutate(type = "predator", reps = paste0(reference,name)) #label and add pseudoreplication label
prey <- full_dat %>% 
  dplyr::select(reference, name = prey_common, change_overlap, shift_diurnal = py_shift_dirunal) %>% 
   mutate(type = "prey", reps = paste0(reference,name)) #label and add pseudoreplication label

dat_labeled <- rbind(pred, prey) #recombine labeled dataset

# Plot change to diurnality affects overlap
ggplot(data = dat_labeled, aes(x=shift_diurnal, y=change_overlap, color = type)) +
  geom_line(data = dat_labeled, aes(x=shift_diurnal, y=change_overlap, group = reps)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='lm') + 
  xlab("change in diurnal") 
```

```{r}
#Fit linear model
mod <- lmer(change_overlap ~ pr_shift_diurnal + py_shift_dirunal + 
            pr_shift_diurnal*py_shift_dirunal + (1|reference), data = full_dat)
summary(mod)

#SJ Plot of interaction terms...
plot_model(mod, type = "pred", terms = c("pr_shift_diurnal", "py_shift_dirunal"))
```
